result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The module's `*Scoping*` tests pass. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `<doc>` XML, `app.js` or `build-gradle.js` cases, so those matches are untested.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the file pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` was never covered. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`.
- **Generated `.NET` `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by …` JS:** the file patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** the pattern `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so any `*-gradle.js` file matches.

The old matches still hold: `.html` and `.xhtml` pages, and `build.gradle` (which has its own separate rule).

I haven't confirmed that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of those scopes. These rules also require the content pattern to match within the stated line limit.
